description: Large k=7 outputs NOT committed (size). sha256 and byte size of each file as produced by the original run. Regenerate as described in README.md (section Reproduce).

regeneration.group_elems.npy: python3 group.py  (deterministic BFS; regenerated here: sha256 matches)
regeneration.cliques.pkl: python3 cliques.py  (regenerated here under Python 3.14: sha256 matches; under uv Python 3.12 the pickle bytes differ but the list is identical)
regeneration.s2/: stage2.py NWORKERS  (dNNNN.npz per-pair table + stabiliser sizes, eNNNN.xz engine certificates (lzma stream of pickles), vNNNN.pkl survivors; dNNNN.done markers omitted). e*.xz bytes depend on lzma/pickle versions and the 20 s Z-scan time limit; the replayed counts are the invariant.
